definitions.explanation: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

examples.english: I'll get off at the next station.
There is a big shop in front of the station.
In the morning there are a lot of people at the station, so it's hard to get on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{駅|えき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧つ{目|め}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My school is three stops from this station by train, so I leave home at the same time every morning.

notes:
{駅|えき} refers to train and bus stations.

COMPOUNDS:
- {駅前|えきまえ}: area in front of the station
- {駅員|えきいん}: station staff
- {終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}: terminal station
- {乗り換え駅|のりかええき}: transfer station

COMMON STATIONS:
- {東京駅|とうきょうえき}: Tokyo Station
- {新宿駅|しんじゅくえき}: Shinjuku Station
